notes.title: Slavicus
notes.content: In a completely new version of the legendary game Slavicus, updated graphics and physics of the game. An uncompromising battle of the gods for power over the planet awaits you. 20 Heroes, 20 unique locations, company, arena and training.

notes.title: Slavicus 3.0
notes.content: The game was expanded and supplemented, the heroes Moaddib, Isis, Perun, Svarog, Valkyrie, Ares, Horus, Veles were added. The rest of the heroes were supplemented and improved, bugs were fixed, wishes were fulfilled. Lots of new arenas for your enjoyment.

notes.title: SLAVICUS 120 Hz
notes.content: The 60Hz or 120Hz are the refresh rates at which the image redraws on the screen. Displays with a 60Hz refresh rate render images 60 times per second, while the 120Hz refresh rate will display images at 120 times per second. The higher the refresh rate, the bast is the animation and the better the image quality.
